reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Green Plum Refreshing Cleanser 100mL
reviews.text: I’ve really been enjoying this cleanser. It has a soft gel texture that feels gentle on my skin and cleanses thoroughly without leaving it dry or tight. After washing, my face feels fresh, smooth, and comfortable. It removes excess oil and impurities while keeping my skin hydrated. I also like that it has a light, refreshing scent that isn’t overpowering. A small amount is enough for each use, so the product lasts a long time. It has become one of my favorite everyday cleansers, and I would happily repurchase it in the future.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款潔面乳。佢有柔軟嘅gel狀質地，搽上面感覺好溫和，但同時清潔得好徹底，唔會令皮膚變乾或者繃緊。洗面之後，塊面感覺清爽、滑同舒服。佢可以清除多餘油脂同雜質，同時保持皮膚水分。我亦鍾意佢有淡淡嘅清新香味，唔會太搶。每次用嘅量好少就夠，所以一支可以用好耐。佢已經成為我日常最愛用嘅潔面乳之一，將來一定會回購。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Green Plum Refreshing Cleanser 100mL
reviews.text: A bit drying for me! I have dry skin and live in a very humid area.
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講有少少乾！我係乾性皮膚，仲住喺好潮濕嘅地方。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Green Plum Refreshing Cleanser 100mL
reviews.text: Gentle and effective facial cleanser. This is my third time ordering it, and I’ve also purchased it for my friends and daughters, who all love it. It cleanses the skin very well without drying it out, produces a nice lather, and is fragrance-free. Gentle enough to use both morning and evening. I highly recommend it, especially for teenagers and those with sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 溫和又有效嘅潔面乳。呢個已經係我第三次回購，我仲買埋畀朋友同女兒，佢哋都好鍾意。佢清潔皮膚好徹底，但又唔會令皮膚變乾，泡量適中，仲要係無香料。溫和到早晚都用得。強烈推薦，尤其推薦畀青少年同敏感肌嘅人。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Green Plum Refreshing Cleanser 100mL
reviews.text:
✨Hands down, the best face wash for oily skin✨

As you can see in the picture, I have a backup for my backup. As a woman with oily, acne-prone skin that produces a lot of sebum, it is difficult to find a face wash that leaves my skin feeling both clean and moisturized.

This face wash is gentle but leaves your face feeling squeaky clean. It does not dry your face, even if you use it multiple times a day. It only takes a little product to go a long way. It lathers so you know you are emulsifying it, but not anything exaggerated or excessive.

My face tends to be sensitive towards commercial face washes like CeraVe that people swear by, but break my skin out. The only decent wash I used to have was Cetaphil for oily skin. That was until I found this cleanser. If you have used any of these, I highly recommend you switch them for this Green Plum cleanser or at least give it a try; you will not regret it (this coming from a person that struggles to try new products when I feel comfortable
reviews.zh:
✨ 毫無疑問，油性肌嘅最佳洗面奶 ✨

如圖所見，我已經有後備嘅後備。作為一個油性同暗瘡肌嘅女性，皮脂分泌旺盛，要搵到一款可以同時keep住皮膚清潔同保濕嘅洗面奶真係好難。

呢款洗面奶好溫和，但會令塊面feel到極度乾淨。就算一日用幾次都唔會令皮膚變乾。只需要少量就用到好耐。佢會起泡，等你知道已經乳化，但唔會過多或誇張。

我塊面對好似 CeraVe 等大眾推薦嘅洗面奶好敏感，雖然人人話好，但我用完會爆瘡。以前唯一一款我覺得ok嘅係Cetaphil 油性肌專用。直到我發現呢款潔面乳。如果你用過以上任何一款，強烈建議你換呢款綠梅（Green Plum）潔面乳，或者至少一試，你一定唔會後悔（呢句話嚟自一個習慣咗某款產品就唔願意嘗試新嘢嘅人）。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Green Plum Refreshing Cleanser 100mL
reviews.text: I have extremely dry and sensitive skin with a damaged barrier from many different face washes that were not suited for my skin. THIS one however is absolutely fabulous and leaves my skin so soft! I double cleanse when I wear make up with the Clean it Zero balm first and then with this BOJ Green Plum cleanser and it leaves my skin like I'm ready for my k-drama debut as the female lead!
reviews.zh: 我有極乾同敏感肌，之前因為用咗好多唔適合自己皮膚嘅洗面奶，搞到皮膚屏障受損。但呢款完全係一流，搽完皮膚超軟！化妝嘅時候我會用 Clean it Zero 卸妝膏做第一次清潔，再用呢款 BOJ Green Plum 潔面乳做第二次，洗完之後皮膚好似準備緊出道做韓劇女主角咁！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Green Plum Refreshing Cleanser 100mL
reviews.text: This is a very gentle gel cleanser. It doesn’t leave my skin dry or feeling stripped, it just feels soft. You also don’t need to use a lot of product because a little goes a long way. I think on days when you don’t have much to wash off your face this would be good but maybe not for those who do unless, you double cleanse.
reviews.zh: 呢款係好溫和嘅gel狀潔面乳。佢唔會令皮膚變乾或者有被抽乾嘅感覺，只係好柔軟。而且唔需要用好多，慳用量。我覺得如果當日塊面冇咩要洗嘅話，呢款好啱，但如果要洗好多嘢，單用就未必夠，要配合雙重清潔先得。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Green Plum Refreshing Cleanser 100mL
reviews.text:
One of the gentlest and hydrating cleansers I've tried so far! It doesn't strip/dry out my skin after cleansing and instead makes it feel soft & plump.

It took me a long time to finally find a cleanser like this. 

One downside is that it might be too gentle and not so effective at removing heavy makeup or sunscreen. So I like using this in the morning.
reviews.zh:
係我而家用過最溫和、最保濕嘅潔面乳之一！用完之後唔會抽乾或者令皮膚變乾，反而令皮膚感覺柔軟同飽滿。

我搵咗好耐先搵到一款好似佢咁嘅潔面乳。

一個缺點係佢可能太溫和，對於卸除厚重嘅化妝或者防晒就唔算好有效。所以我鍾意朝早用佢。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Green Plum Refreshing Cleanser 100mL
reviews.text:
I've been looking for a water-based cleanser that wouldn't dry my skin out or make it feel tight for ages, but I've finally found it! This cleanser is so refreshing and light to use on top of being non-irritating. A little goes a long way too, so despite being 100ml it'll last quite a while.
Highly recommend this to fellow people with dry skin!
reviews.zh:
我搵咗好耐一款水基底嘅潔面乳，唔會令皮膚變乾或者繃緊，最終畀我搵到啦！呢款潔面乳好清爽、好輕，仲唔刺激。少量就用到好耐，所以雖然只有100ml，但都可以用好一段時間。
強烈推薦畀同我一樣嘅乾性肌！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
